coordinates: Pixel bounds use bottom-left coordinates with exclusive right/top edges; row/column are zero-based from top-left.
quadrantOrder: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-left, 3 bottom-right; each input is 4 columns by 5 rows.
assignment: Original quadrant row/column slot is authoritative. Each major pixel median must occupy a unique slot, remain at least 0.15 cell inside its boundary, and agree with the nearest source-body frame. Source distance and runner-up margin remain diagnostics.
placement: Integer translation only. Prefer alpha>128 bbox centers at normalized source bbox centers, rounded to the nearest pixel. If no centered layout fits at or below 4096, use a 4096 square and clamp each preferred integer translation to the nearest allowed translation inside its original cell with a one-pixel gutter. Report every correction; native RGBA pixels and frame identities are unchanged.
limitations: No resizing, redrawing, filtering, color/alpha correction, PPU assignment, slicing or visual approval. Separate measurement and visual review are required.
weakOwnershipPolicy: Eight-connected alpha>128 major figures and alpha>8 major regions must each number 20 per input and correspond one-to-one. Alpha 1..8 pixels use the nearest alpha>8 figure pixel (Euclidean pixel-center distance); equal-distance owners resolve to the lowest original frame index. No RGBA values or nontransparent pixels are removed.
